question: Show the top 5 products by revenue
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How much revenue did we make last month?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', now())

question: Which customers have placed more than three orders?
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > 3 ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: Show each product category and its total sales
reference_sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS total_sales FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id=cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.category_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC

question: How many orders were cancelled?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: Which month had the highest revenue?
reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: List customers who have never placed an order
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id) ORDER BY c.id

question: Which products have never been sold?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id=p.id) ORDER BY p.id
